## File: facebookresearch_reagent/serving/external/nlohmann_json/benchmarks/thirdparty/benchmark/mingw.py

Prompts

```
['download a specific version of MinGW compiler for a given architecture and threading model', 'parse the mingw-builds repository file to get available compiler versions and configurations', 'locate the 7zip executable on the system via PATH or Windows registry', 'unpack a mingw-builds archive to a specified location using 7zip', 'search for an executable file in the system PATH directories']
```

Usage

```
{'download_mingw': 'download a specific version of MinGW compiler for a given architecture and threading model', 'parse_repository': 'parse the mingw-builds repository file to get available compiler versions and configurations', 'find_7zip': 'locate the 7zip executable on the system via PATH or Windows registry', 'unpack_archive': 'unpack a mingw-builds archive to a specified location using 7zip', 'find_in_path': 'search for an executable file in the system PATH directories'}
```
